description: Semantic MCP text/formatting tools (document_editor_insert_text/replace_text/delete_text/format_range/set_heading/set_paragraph_properties). Address blocks by blockId + optional tableCellId and text ranges as plain-text offset/length per docs/document-mcp-addressing.md; compile into canonical insertText/deleteText/addInlineMark/removeInlineMark/setBlockAttribute operations applied through DocumentOperationApplier + provider save — the same path as document_editor_apply_operations, preserving optimistic concurrency and collaboration convergence.
